description: This PHP source file defines the BotControllerListener class, which subscribes to various application and kernel events within a project, and handles the creation and management of milestones, as well as sending notifications via a Telegram bot when certain events occur.

classes.name: BotControllerListener
classes.description: A class that listens to kernel and application events to trigger milestone creation and send bot messages in response to project and investment events.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Handles the controller event to determine if a certain controller is invoked and initializes bot sidebar creation if applicable.

methods.name: create_milestone
methods.description: Creates a milestone for the given project and type, and sends notifications via Telegram bot if configured.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles the ProjectActive event to create a milestone based on project progress and days elapsed.

methods.name: onInvestSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful investment events to create progress milestones based on invested percentage thresholds.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish events to create a milestone upon project publication.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and corresponding handler methods that this class subscribes to, including controller, investment, project active, and publish events.
